g.data-note: The Deeping-stream slips out under the wall through a narrow barred arch.
An old fortress-tower on its rock spur, keeping watch over the mouth of the gorge.
Heavy timber gates at the head of the causeway, the only way in from the coomb.
A stone ramp climbing from the valley floor up to the Hornburg's gate.
A long wall closing the gorge, its parapet lit by torches against the rain.
